title: Faiwol language - Wikipedia
text: Faiwol is one of the Ok languages of Papua New Guinea and Indonesia. It is spoken at the headwaters of the Fly, Palmer, and Murray rivers in Western Province. [2] There are numerous dialects, including Faiwol proper, Angkiyak, Wopkei, Setaman, Selbang, [3] Dimtikin, [4] and Kauwol [5] on the Indonesian border.

text: Faiwol is a Trans–New Guinea language belonging to the Ok branch, spoken primarily by around 3,000 people in the headwaters of the Fly and Palmer rivers in the Western Province of Papua New Guinea.

text: Apr 23, 2026 · Faiwol Faiwol is member of the Mountain Ok branch of the Trans-New Guinea language family.
